title: Canopy plugin
subtitle: How the plugin works · select a node, then K / X / C / A or write a note

root.name: canopy
root.note: Tree-shaped review and approval gate for Claude's plans. Working name; final name TBD (Prune / Treegate / Canopy).

children.name: Plans too long to read
children.note: Even Claude Code's team said they stopped reading long plans

children.name: Tree + per-node decisions
children.note: No other tool combines a tree view, a choice per node, automatic return to the session and an approval gate

children.name: Plan scope review
children.note: Main use: before Claude writes code

children.name: 1 · Claude writes the tree
children.note: JSON with stable node ids, or a Markdown outline

children.name: 2 · Local server starts
children.note: Python stdlib on 127.0.0.1, secret token in the URL

children.name: 3 · Browser opens the map
children.note: Animated, collapsible, white canvas

children.name: 4 · You decide per node
children.note: Keep / Cut / Change / Ask + notes

children.name: 5 · Summary, then send
children.note: Review everything before it goes back

children.name: 6 · Result back in session
children.note: Markdown or JSON with status and decisions

children.name: 7 · Claude acts on it
children.note: Answers asks, applies changes, removes cuts

children.name: Review
children.note: Collect feedback; status: submitted

children.name: Gate (--gate)
children.note: Approve unlocks only after every top-level branch is reviewed; status: approved or changes_requested

children.name: Export PLAN.md
children.note: --export-plan writes the approved tree as a checklist, cuts removed

children.name: Select vs open
children.note: Click label = select; + = open/close

children.name: Keyboard
children.note: K Keep · X Cut · C Change · A Ask · arrows move · N next unreviewed · F fit

children.name: Legend & badges
children.note: Letters on badges, not colour alone

children.name: Drafts saved
children.note: On disk; survive reload and closed tab

children.name: Statuses
children.note: approved · changes_requested · submitted · closed · closed_tab · timeout

children.name: JSON (--json)
children.note: decisions[{id, path, decision, text}], general, stats

children.name: Exit codes
children.note: 0 done · 2 bad input · 3 timeout · 4 tab closed

children.name: Secret session token
children.note: Fake requests get 403 (tested)

children.name: Fully offline
children.note: d3 bundled, system fonts
